en: That's some warped logic you have.
Well, what're we waiting for? Climb into that taxi of yours⑬or should I say, your coffin!
Fine. I'll show you what this coffin can do.
Don't do it, Suzuki-san! Didn't you hear what I said!?
I know you're fast, but going up against Crash Kajiwara is suicide!
If you don't watch out, you'll lose more than the race. He could literally kill you!

...You know, you still haven't learned proper manners.
Focus on doing your job, all right?
Gah! Don't you get it!? Why are you risking your life like this!?
Because I made a promise.
A promise?

That's right. I promised to take down the Devil Killers.
And what good is a man's word if he doesn't back it up?
...That another life lesson for me?
Pretty much. Besides, there's no way I'm backing down.
Ooh, well la di da! I like your style, man! Sucks that I'm gonna have to kill ya, though. Maybe break a few bones, at the very least.
Wait for me at the finish line. I'll make it through this.
...I believe you.
Bahahah! Don't get too down on yourself. No way a taxi driver's getting the better of me.
At least you didn't get killed, huh? Guess I decided to have mercy on ya.
Do come by and give it another shot, though! Can't guarantee you'll live through it, but what the hell!
Fuck me. I lost the race... Now I lost the brawl, too. That's a first.
Still got some fight in you?
Nope, nope! I'm good. No more! Please.
Cretin. And you label yourself among the Four Kings? Utterly pathetic.

Sorry you had to waste time on this imbecile, Suzuki-san.
Clearly he picked the wrong opponent.
Good to see someone with some sense around here.
Yes, but unfortunately I'm not here to chat.
The only thing I want to hear from you is the sound of your engine when we race.

Heh. And here I was, thinking you were a level-headed guy.
I guess you're just another adrenaline junkie.

Perhaps so. I must say, the prospect of speeding down the
highway neck and neck does rather excite me.
You should know, Crash Kajiwara is the weakest link in the Four Kings. Don't expect your next race to go so smoothly.
So you're really gonna take on Cool Yoshimi!?
It looks that way.
I don't get it, Suzuki-san. You drive like the wind, you're tough as nails in a fight... Who exactly are you?
Just a humble taxi driver.

Anyway, now you know how to handle complaints.
Let's head back to the office.
You're finally learning some manners, I see. Good on you.
Haha, you know it! I'm so polite, I put the "man" in "manners." Ain't no one more respectful than this bad boy!
Holy guacamole, Suzuki-san. You beat Crash Kajiwara!
That's bullshit! There's no way I could lose to some two-bit chauffer!
Give me one more shot! I'll get you this time!
I don't think so. I can't let you disgrace the Devil Killers' name any further.
(Another one...?)
Huh? The hell are you doing here?
Who's that, Kiyokawa?
Oh man, oh god... Oh man, oh god!
It's Yoshimi!
Who's Yoshimi?

He's one of the Four Kings! They call him Cool Yoshimi!
He's cold, he's calculating, he's the king of the⑬
Shut the fuck up, kid!
Yargh!
What're you doing here, Yoshimi?
Why, I was watching you sputter and fail. What else?
See, if you had lost⑬which you did⑬the onus would fall on me to restore our honor. Thus, I had to come see Suzuki-san's racing for myself.
What? You saying you expected me to lose today!?
Isn't that precisely what happened?
It's not over yet! By my rules, even if you lose the race, it doesn't count as long as you win the fight after!
You and me, Suzuki! Right here, right now! I'll put you in intensive care for a year!
You're really out for blood, aren't you? I thought the Devil Killers' top men would have a little more decency than that.
You'll have to forgive him, Suzuki-san. This is just how he gets.

Heheh. Y'all say what you want. Now put 'em up!
I'm 'bout to come crashing down on ya!
We're back.
Oh, hello there. How did it go? Did you sort things out with that angry customer?
I'd say I worked things out, though I practically begged for forgiveness.
He must have been really upset, huh? Now you've seen the hard part of the job, Kiyokawa.
I'll say! Suzuki-san looked amazing out there!
He what? I thought you just went to apologize...
You got 1,600 experience points.
Gah, you're late! I'm in a hurry here!
I have to get to my grandson's birthday party!
I need you to do whatever it takes to get me to <Color:22>Fukuhaku Street<Color:Default> as soon as possible!
You made it! Thanks so much. I'm sure you'd make a great father.
That's kind of you to say. Go see your grandson.
I will! Thanks again!
Thanks, driver!
Glad to be of service.
I'd better get going, then!
What are you playing at? Your driving is terrible!
Oh, forget it. I need to get going!
(I guess I needed to go a little faster. I'll have to keep that in mind next time.)
Ugh... I don't feel too good. Guess I had too much to drink.
Oh geez, I think I'm gonna throw up... Get me to <Color:22>Nagasugawa Street<Color:Default> as gently as you can, please.
Man, not only did you get here without me throwing up, I actually feel better! Thanks!
Always a pleasure.
I'll definitely ask for you when I'm sober next time!
Thank you. I think I'm okay now.
Try not to overdo the drink next time.
Yeah. Well, later!
Ugh... You need to take some driving lessons.
(I guess my driving made him feel worse. I'll have to watch out for that.)
Oh, that's from someone who referred to himself as "a pedigreed hound." He could've just used his name, if you ask me...
(That must be Muramatsu-san... formerly of Formula 1.)
We're in a real fix now! Muramatsu-kun had a call come in requestin' him, but he's gone off the radar again!
I'll make sure he gets there today.
Huh? You know where he is, Suzuki-san?
Well, no... But I'll find out.
That just came in now. It's the client who always calls from the highway rest area.
(In other words, the Devil Killers.)
Then I'll be heading out.
Wonderful. Have a safe drive.
Oh hey, Suzuki-san! You haven't seen Muramatsu-kun around, have ya?
No, I'm afraid not.
That's mighty odd...
We had a request come in specifically for him, but somehow he's up and gone. Haven't seen hide nor hair of him.
Doesn't sound like the Muramatsu-san I know.
Ain't that the truth? He's usually such a stickler about everything!
If it turns out he can't show up, can you send someone else in his place?
Mm, apparently this client only wants rides from him. They said if he's not there, they'll never call us again.
Car's all washed! And boy, does that baby sparkle!
Ah, Kiyokawa-kun. Ya seen Muramatsu-kun around?
Uhh, we were talking not too long ago, but I haven't seen him since. Why?
Hrm. Guess he slipped away.
How about I go look for him?
Yeah, I'll help too.
I appreciate that, but you two got yer own work to do. No point wastin' everybody's time.
Y'all get back to what you were doin'. I'll handle this myself.
Okey-doke!
You said you spoke with Muramatsu-san earlier. What was it about?
Oh, I was just telling him how you kicked Crash Kajiwara to the curb!
Hey, I told you not to go running your mouth about that.
Oh, come on. What's the harm? At this rate you'll take down the Four Kings in no time!
And once you beat the Devil Killers' elite, you'll be the fastest guy in Fukuoka!
That's pretty much all I said.
I don't care about any of that. This isn't about fame or cheap thrills.
Yeah, I know... Guess I got a little carried away. Besides, no one expects a taxi driver to climb to the top of the leaderboard anyway.
What did Muramatsu-san have to say about it?
He uh, mentioned something about how it's stupid and pointless to be racing on the streets. I think.
Actually, I don't remember. I kinda got selective hearing, y'know?
Ooh, speaking of racing, when's your next one? I can't wait to see you out there!
Never mind that. You need to focus on your job.
Listen. I don't want you causing any more trouble for the chief.
Hmph. You're just mad that I beat you in our last race. You're back for more, aren't you?
I can tell. Street racer types are always sore losers.
Think what you like about me. All I want is for you to get back to work once I win.
Hah, not likely. I'll have you howling in defeat in no time!
(Three out of Four Kings to go. Hope I can put this racing business to rest before long.)
Suzuki-san?
Muramatsu-san! What are you doing here? The chief's been looking all over for you.
Is that so? Then what's your excuse for being here?
I'm here to race the Devil Killers. Nothing more.
Uh-huh. I hear you're doing pretty well against them.
You could say I'm making progress.
Hmph. You just can't wait to be glorified as Fukuoka's fastest, can you?
I don't know what you heard from Kiyokawa, but that's not what I'm in it for.
But that's beside the point, Muramatsu-san. There's an important client waiting to be picked up, and you'll still have time to make it if you leave now.
Then we'd better get this race over quickly.
"We"?
That's what I said. Today it's gonna be just you and me. I made that call.
See, I know all about how you guys think. I trained to be a racer myself⑬a real one. Formula 1, to be precise.
And I must say, I wasn't half-bad. Made it through the amateur leagues just fine. If things had gone my way, I could have been a pro by now.
Do you know how much it costs to turn pro in the racing world? You need a machine, circuit fees, campaign money, testing...
I was scraping together every last yen I could. But my family is poor, and my part-time job only paid a pittance.
In the end, I couldn't keep chasing the dream. Didn't have the money.
What does any of this have to do with me?
I despise people like you. People who go speeding down the highway like it's nothing. Like people's lives aren't at risk.
Those who really aim for speed do it on a proper track, following the proper regulations.
Racing side by side with ordinary people just trying to get around safely is a slap in the face to society. Don't you think?
I agree. The only reason I'm going up against the Devil Killers is to get them off the road.
...I don't believe you for a minute. I can tell you're enjoying it. Reveling in it, even.
You're wrong.
My point is, the fact that you compete on public roads really grates at my nerves!
For those of us who grew up on the track, beating street racers like you is easy as pie. You'll see.
I still don't see any reason for us to race. Now come on, we've got our jobs to do.
Hmph. Okay then, how about this? Race me, and I'll go straight to work if you win.
That won't prove anything. And look at us. We're taxi drivers, arguing over whether or not we should be speeding down the highway. Come on, we're going back.
Not until you accept my challenge!
(Looks like he's not going to budge on this one.)
Fine. If you want it that badly, I'll give you your race.
Finally he gets the picture. Time to teach you the difference between an amateur and a pro!
Hah! That's what you get for swerving around on the road instead of finding an actual track!
You can think of us circuit racers like pedigreed hounds, while street racers like you are nothing but stray mongrels.
Don't lump me in with that crowd. I'm not one of them.
Well you have yet to convince me. After all, you just raced me, didn't you! But I understand how losing like this might leave a bad taste in your mouth.
I'll give you a rematch anytime. Just don't get your hopes up, you wannabe.
Heheheh... Hahahahaha!
About that client who was askin' for Muramatsu-san.
It sounds like he'll make do with another driver for now.
Maybe, but if this happens again, we'll lose his business to another party.
I just wish I knew where Muramatsu-kun snuck off to.
Lemme know if you see him, 'kay?
All that training on the circuit... all that time and dedication... only to lose to a street racer?
I'll say it one more time, Muramatsu-san. I'm not a street racer, and I never intend to be.
Heh. Yeah... I know.
Deep down, I think I just wanted an excuse to race you.
I was jealous, okay? Everyone was making a fuss about you beating the Devil Killers and being the best in town.
And yet I thought in my heart I was the faster man. It bugged me to no end. But now I know the truth.
You beat me fair and square, Suzuki-san. You cut me down to size, but I'm honestly glad you did. I'll be rooting for you from now on.
